entities.summary: Georgii Kushitashvili is a Russian-Georgian boxer. He competed at the 2022 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the gold medal in the cruiserweight event. He also competed at the 2023 IBA Men's World Boxing Championships, winning the bronze medal in the same event.
